Mixamo (Adobe) assets, added on the user's request after test 2 (not part of the test 1 asset set).
Downloaded 2026-10-26 from mixamo.com with the user's account, format "FBX for Unity".
Characters (T-pose, with skin): Y Bot, Remy, Kate.
Animations (Y Bot skeleton, without skin, 30 fps, In Place): Walking (Male Standard Walk),
Female Walk (Female Normal Walk), Running (Running With Intention), Jogging, Swimming, Treading Water.
Weapon locomotion (added later, same account and settings, Y Bot skeleton, In Place):
Rifle_Walk (Rifle Walk Forward), Rifle_Run (Rifle Run Forward), Pistol_Walk (Walking With An Aimed Pistol),
Pistol_Run (Running With A Pistol), Axe_Walk (Walking Forward With Axe), Axe_Run (Running Forward With Axe).
Playable character (fifth run, same account and settings, Y Bot skeleton, In Place where Mixamo offers it):
Rifle 8-Way Locomotion Pack clips R_Idle (Idle), R_WalkB/L/R (Walk Backward/Left/Right), R_RunB/L/R (Run Backward/Left/Right),
R_Sprint (Sprint Forward), R_JumpLoop (Jump Loop); R_Reload (Reloading Rifle While Standing);
Pistol/Handgun Locomotion Pack clips P_Idle (Pistol Idle), P_WalkB (Pistol Walk Backward), P_StrafeL/R (Pistol Strafe),
P_RunB (Pistol Run Backward); P_Reload (Gun Reload While Walking);
Pro Melee Axe Pack clips M_Idle (Standing Idle), M_WalkB/L/R (Standing Walk Back/Left/Right), M_RunB (Standing Run Back),
M_Attack (Standing Melee Attack Horizontal); unarmed U_Idle (Unarmed Idle), U_WalkB (Walking Backwards),
U_WalkL/R (Left/Right Strafe Walk), U_RunL/R (Left/Right Strafe), U_RunB (Unarmed Run Back), U_Fall (Falling Idle),
U_Throw (Grenade Throw While Walking); crowd deaths N_Death1 (Dying Backwards), N_Death2 (Dying, shot to the chest).
R_IdleAim (Rifle 8-Way pack Idle Aiming) is the rifle stance idle.
